identitySignals: Delaware business license record (OpenGovUS) lists legal name NEW DIRECTION SOLUTIONS, LLC with trade name PROCARE THERAPY, matching the agenda's 'New Direction Solutions dba Procare Therapy'

Same record gives 5550 Peachtree Pkwy, Peachtree Corners, GA, matching the agenda location 'Peachtree Corners, GA'; LinkedIn also lists ProCare Therapy headquarters at 5550 Peachtree Parkway, Peachtree Corners, GA

LinkedIn describes ProCare Therapy as a school-based therapy staffing company (speech, occupational, physical therapy, school psychology, nursing), consistent with OUSD's special education nonpublic agency contract for COVID support personnel
research.notes: The company's own site (procaretherapy.com) blocks automated fetching (403), so website, summary and headquarters rest on LinkedIn and the address on a Delaware business license listing. Phone and email were seen only in search snippets and could not be verified on a fetchable page, so they are left null. The Delaware license is only a registry-style listing; the entity is not confirmed on the California SOS or SAM.gov.
